editorial:
Imagine moving to a quiet Florida town after losing your parents, only to find out the locals are way scarier than any ghost story. You follow Anna, a lonely girl who just wants to fit in. She hangs out with two local teens who seem cool at first, but things go south fast when they do something truly evil. Suddenly, Anna is stuck in a nightmare because of a monster called Mr. Sandman. This creepy kid spirit hunts bullies in their sleep and then takes their eyes when they wake up. The vibe is super tense, and you can feel Anna's panic as she realizes she is next on the list.

The acting is great, especially how the movie makes you feel the dread in every scene. The pacing stays quick, so you won't find yourself checking your phone. One downside is that some of the gore might be too much for some people, but if you love scary movies, it is a ride. It is a perfect pick for a weekend with friends who like a good scare.
endingExplained: In the end, Anna realizes the only way to stop Mr. Sandman is to truly apologize and make things right for the people they hurt. She manages to outsmart the spirit by facing her fears instead of running. After a final, bloody fight, she breaks the curse by sacrificing her own safety to save others. The twist is that the spirit was her own distant relative, and once he finds peace, he finally disappears for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves supernatural slashers and creepy urban legends.
